title: Require Service Contract Authority
forbids: a module contract directory whose index lacks one generic exported contract anchor or at least one filename-mapped direct leaf import; contract source acquiring module implementation, router, or middleware faces; a contract leaf cycling through its own index; a direct contract leaf without exactly one filename-mapped operation or group export; a loose export or import alias except the exact local binding required for an ECMAScript-reserved operation name; a contract operation or group without Standard Schema adaptation at every input, output, or public error-data position; a contract or reusable DTO schema using executable, unsafe, native-only, or pre-2020-12 TypeBox capabilities; private support that is not bounded and reachable when present; imported, computed, or exported error-map authority or an imported named error item; and parallel request, response, envelope, error-map, schema, type, or helper authority
why: A module contract directory exposes one generic native oRPC contract authority through index.ts while direct semantic leaves own one operation or deliberate group. An ECMAScript-reserved public key retains its exact semantic name through one language-required local binding rather than opening general aliasing. Public input, output, and error-data schemas use TypeBox's native JSON Schema builders and one Standard Schema adapter without silently projecting away runtime semantics, while bounded private composition and locally attached error items can reduce repeated syntax without creating custom error constructors.
remediate: Export the generic contract only from contract/index.ts and prove at least one filename-mapped direct leaf import. Compose that acquired leaf anywhere in the plain or native nested contract tree; TypeScript owns completeness, Knip owns import reachability, and generated client/API behavior proof owns the complete public operation set. Keep contract source independent of module implementation, router, and middleware faces, and keep leaves independent of their own index. Give each kebab-case leaf exactly one lower-camel runtime export mapped from its filename. For an ECMAScript-reserved operation only, declare `<name>Contract`, export it as `<name>`, and import that public name as the same `<name>Contract` binding in index.ts. Keep leaf-local schemas, native error maps, shared fragments, and helpers private and syntactically reachable from that exported value. Remove executable, unsafe, native-only, and tuple capabilities from public schemas, and apply standard(TypeBoxSchema) at every input, output, and public error-data position. Declare public errors with inline or bounded private native .errors maps, keep every shorthand error item locally declared and attached to the owning exported contract, then use the handler-supplied errors constructors in procedures.
message: Service module contract directories must preserve one generic entrypoint and declarative TypeBox/native error authority in their leaves.
